label: baseline
description: One LLM call: full schema with column descriptions + BIRD evidence, one direct candidate. No linking, voting, repair, verifier or cache.

questions.pred_sql:
SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic'
  AND l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format = 'gladiator'

SELECT 
    CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = 24) AS REAL) / 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = 24) AS ratio

SELECT
  substr(y.Date, 5, 2) AS month
FROM
  yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE
  c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
GROUP BY
  substr(y.Date, 5, 2)
ORDER BY
  SUM(y.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND substr(pa.date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015'

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    CAST((d.A13 - d.A12) AS REAL) / d.A12 * 100 AS unemployment_increment_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 19
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_count
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
GROUP BY e.event_id
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 10

SELECT id
FROM publisher
WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek'

SELECT
  p.Diagnosis,
  l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = 30609

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_oxygen
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

failures.evidence: players age at present = SUBTRACT((DATETIME(), birthday)); sprint speed of no less than 97 refers to sprint_speed > = 97; between 2013 to 2015 refers to YEAR(date) > = '2013' AND YEAR(date) < = '2015';

failures.question: For loans contracts which are still running where client are in debt, list the district of the and the state the percentage unemployment rate increment from year 1995 to 1996.
failures.evidence: Unemployment increment rate in percentage = [(unemployment rate 2016 - unemployment rate 2015) / unemployment rate 2015] * 100; unemployment rate 2015 appears in the A12; unemployment rate 2016 appears in the A13; Loan contracts which are still running where client are in debt can be presented as status = 'D'
